description: This file defines the FeatureAttribute class used for annotating modules with feature metadata in OrchardCore, including properties like Id, Name, Category, Dependencies, and methods for parsing dependencies and retrieving descriptive info.

classes.name: FeatureAttribute
classes.description: Represents a feature within a module, with properties for Id, Name, Description, Category, Dependencies, Priority, and flags for tenant and dependency restrictions. Includes methods for parsing dependencies and retrieving descriptive info.

methods.name: FeatureAttribute
methods.description: Constructor initializing all properties with parameters, including Id, Name, Category, Priority, Description, Dependencies, and flags.

methods.name: Exists
methods.description: Indicates whether the feature exists based on whether Id is set.

methods.name: Id
methods.description: Getter and setter for the feature's unique identifier, throws if set to null or empty.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Getter and setter for the feature's human-readable name, defaults to Id if not set.

methods.name: Category
methods.description: Category used for grouping in UI, trimmed when set.

methods.name: InternalPriority
methods.description: Parsed integer value of Priority, or null if invalid.

methods.name: Dependencies
methods.description: Array of feature dependency IDs, trimmed.

methods.name: DefaultTenantOnly
methods.description: Flag indicating if only default tenant can enable/disable.

methods.name: IsAlwaysEnabled
methods.description: Flag indicating if feature is always enabled and cannot be disabled.

methods.name: EnabledByDependencyOnly
methods.description: Flag indicating if feature can only be enabled as a dependency.

methods.name: Describe
methods.description: Returns the first non-empty description from this or additional features.

methods.name: Categorize
methods.description: Returns the first non-empty category from this or additional features.

methods.name: Prioritize
methods.description: Returns the first valid priority value from this or additional features.

methods.name: ParseDependencies
methods.description: Static method to parse a delimited string into an array of dependency IDs.
